content: The customer, Nandini Rajput, inquires about the new policy's premium payment frequency (monthly vs. yearly), how to switch from her expired policy to the new one, and whether she can retain her previous coverage. The agent, Anjali Desai, clarifies that the quoted premium is yearly with a monthly payment option, explains that an expired policy requires a new application, offers to email the application link, and addresses coverage continuity questions.

action_items: Agent to send a link to the new application form via email
Agent to clarify coverage details compared to the old policy
